title: Raku Firing Workshops
source_quote: Different from firing a piece in a kiln, a Raku firing is done outdoors using a large gas kiln. Pieces are heated to 1,850 degrees Fahrenheit.
evidence_sentence: Raku firings are offered as bookable workshops where participants bring bisque work and experience the traditional firing process.
evidence_quote: a Raku firing is done outdoors using a large gas kiln
summary: Book a raku firing workshop (3–5 hours). Bring bisque pieces with raku glaze applied. Groups from 1 to 25+ people. BYOB. Proper attire required (no open-toed shoes, long sleeves and pants).
bring: Bisque-fired pieces with raku glaze applied
